name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 65 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.7 days starting 2025-12-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.89 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
